scope: Fix exactly the four reproduced Compute controls; retain native configuration semantics and exact project-bound joins.

changes.behavior: Recognizes documented TLS_1_3 only with RESTRICTED profile; invalid/unrecognized pairings remain UNKNOWN. Full/partial SSL policy links normalize within the explicit GCP project; ambiguous normalized aliases cannot pass.

Canonicalizes official Google Compute full, API-relative, project-qualified and project-relative backend URLs. Joins preserve project, region/global location and resource kind, and reject unknown authorities, credentials, ports, query/fragment suffixes, path escapes and ambiguous normalized matches.
changes.configuration_limit: Backend logging declaration only; no endpoint reachability, actual log delivery or effective access claim.

changes.behavior: Uses readable observed alternative configs even when another query is denied; an unfiltered covering config can establish enablement. Missing/denied/partial alternatives cannot prove absence; filtered-only evidence under incomplete coverage is UNKNOWN and under complete coverage is MANUAL. Complete empty/disabled/nonmatching alternatives retain FAIL when subnet logging is off.
changes.helper_safety: Native config state/filter/target/identity fields use strict accessors; foreign hosts, conflicting selectors and conflicting identities remain unresolved. Explicit denied legacy fields cannot be treated as omitted defaults.
changes.configuration_limit: Configuration-only logging enablement; traffic coverage, sampling and actual delivery remain separate.

changes.behavior: Requires enabled OS Login as well as the 2FA flag. Explicit disabled OS Login fails, malformed/duplicate flags are UNKNOWN, unset 2FA fails, and true 2FA with unset OS Login needs readable effective compute.requireOsLogin or stays UNKNOWN.
changes.configuration_limit: Project/policy declaration only; instance overrides, guest enforcement and principal eligibility are not certified.

--- peaso.checks.gcp_ports_relationships.compute_reference:before
+++ peaso.checks.gcp_ports_relationships.compute_reference:after
@@ -0,0 +1,30 @@
+def compute_reference(reference, scope, kinds):
+    """Canonicalize documented Compute URL forms within one explicit project."""
+    from urllib.parse import urlsplit
+    if not isinstance(scope, str) or not re.fullmatch(r"projects/[A-Za-z0-9_-]+", scope):
+        raise Unavailable("Compute project scope unavailable")
+    if not isinstance(reference, str) or not reference:
+        raise Unavailable("Compute resource reference unavailable")
+    parsed = urlsplit(reference)
+    if parsed.query or parsed.fragment:
+        raise Unavailable("Compute reference query or fragment unsupported")
+    if parsed.scheme or parsed.netloc:
+        if parsed.scheme != "https" or parsed.netloc not in ("www.googleapis.com", "compute.googleapis.com"):
+            raise Unavailable("foreign Compute reference authority")
+        value = parsed.path
+        if not value.startswith("/compute/v1/projects/"):
+            raise Unavailable("unsupported Compute API resource path")
+    else:
+        value = reference
+    value = value.removeprefix("/")
+    if value.startswith("compute/v1/"):
+        value = value.removeprefix("compute/v1/")
+    if value.startswith(("global/", "regions/")):
+        value = scope + "/" + value
+    match = re.fullmatch(r"(projects/[A-Za-z0-9_-]+)/(global|regions/[a-z][a-z0-9-]*)/"
+                         r"(sslPolicies|backendServices|backendBuckets|urlMaps|targetHttpsProxies|targetSslProxies)/"
+                         r"([a-z](?:[-a-z0-9]*[a-z0-9])?)", value)
+    if (not match or match[1] != scope or match[3] not in kinds
+            or match[3] == "backendBuckets" and match[2] != "global"):
+        raise Unavailable("Compute reference outside the exact project/resource scope")
+    return value
